clean.title: Why hot coffee cools fastest at first
clean.body:
Heat leaves a cup at a rate that grows with the temperature difference between the coffee and the room. Fresh coffee is far hotter than the air, so it loses heat quickly; as it cools the gap shrinks and the loss slows.

| Stage | Coffee vs room | Heat loss |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early | Large gap | Faster |
| Late | Small gap | Slower |
